Usage: actual transactions [options] [command]

Manage transactions

Options:
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]         List transactions for an account
  add [options]          Add transactions to an account
  import [options]       Import transactions to an account
  update [options] <id>  Update a transaction
  delete <id>            Delete a transaction
  help [command]         display help for command
